text:
releasebot: DeployBot triggered: hotfix candidate v2026.03.23-hotfix-1 queued for prod-embeddings (region: eu-west1). Reason: spike in embed 5xx rate ~10:45Z. Please ack and provide expedited approval or rollback criteria. CI: green. Link: https://redwood-internal/release/2026.03.23-hotfix-1

hannah: tagging SRE/ML oncall — is this the kv-cache drop we saw in staging?

samir: yes, small fix to kvcache eviction logic (commit abc1234). Root cause was race during cache purge under load. No model changes.

hannah: thanks. can we pin the canary to 10% first, healthcheck 2m, then ramp? we might need fast rollback plan.

samir: agree. plan: canary -> 2% for 2m -> 10% for 5m -> 50% -> 100% if metrics stable. rollback criteria: embed 5xx > 0.5% over baseline OR p95 latency +30% OR error budget fire.

devon: i can approve expedited. i want release notes & changelog link before full ramp.

alejandro: +1 from infra. oncall will watch. If anything odd, we roll to previous image: v2026.03.22-stable (image: registry/redwood/embed:v2026.03.22-stable).

hannah: tagging @devon for formal ok to skip standard 1-hour wait and fasttrack to canary now.

devon: ok from me. approve fasttrack for canary. :thumbsup:

releasebot: Received approvals: devon, alejandro. Initiating canary deploy to prod-embeddings (10% traffic pinned to v2026.03.23-hotfix-1, canary window 7m).

releasebot: Deploy command run by hannah: ```
kubectl set image deployment/embeddings-server embeddings=registry/redwood/embed:v2026.03.23-hotfix-1 --record
kubectl rollout status deployment/embeddings-server -n prod --watch
```

hannah: added release note snippet: "Fix: kvcache purge race causing transient 5xx on heavy embed traffic. No model change. Rolling canary now." Link to full notes: https://redwood-internal/docs/releases/2026-03-23-hotfix-1

samir: watching metrics (logs, 5xx, p95) and kv-cache evictions. will post updates every 2m.

alejandro: infra telemetry shows normal pod health and no CPU spike.

releasebot: Canary at 2% complete -> healthchecks pass -> bumped to 10% per plan.

hannah: monitoring looks clean for first 3m.

samir: no increase in 5xx so far. p95 latency nominal. continuing.

releasebot: After 7m canary, metrics stable -> proceeding to 50% (manual approval bypassed per expedited signoff).

devon: saw the canary notes, ack full ramp if metrics remain stable at 50% for next 5m.

releasebot: 50% held for 5m, metrics OK. Proceeding to 100% rollout.

hannah: deploying final step now.

releasebot: Rollout complete. All pods on v2026.03.23-hotfix-1. Closing thread in 30m unless rollback triggered.

samir: postmortem draft will be prepared; tagging this as hotfix with expedited approval.

alejandro: FYI ops: add a metric alert tweak to detect this class earlier.

hannah: thanks team. If anyone sees anything weird ping this thread immediately and run: ```
kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeddings-server -n prod
```

releasebot: Note: rollout recorded. Release notes published. :tada:
